dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, jagged high-intensity white perimeters with a rapid gradient shift into dark grey interior centers, localized primarily in the upper-mid dorsal section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical solid light-grey clusters lacking internal gradients is observed on the anterior-lateral region (left), with lower density but larger clusters occurring toward the mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an obtuse, scalene triangle with its longest side oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.
